features.title: Source registry, ingest run logging and failure alerts
acceptance: source_registry and ingest_run populated

Failed ingest runs alert within 15 minutes via n8n email or Slack (primary path); a GitHub issue labeled ingest-alert containing source, run id, error text and timestamp, which notifies George, is kept as the fallback when n8n delivery fails.

#122 is resolved (Cloudflare Bot Fight Mode turned off 2026-10-13); the n8n webhook is protected by the X-FAS-Alert-Secret shared-secret header, and requests without the correct header are rejected (401/403).
The nightly audit goes YELLOW when the n8n ingest-failure-alert webhook is challenged (e.g. HTTP 403) or when ingest-alert issues exist with no matching n8n delivery.
Re-running a vintage does not duplicate rows
features.status_note: n8n email/Slack is the primary alert path; GitHub issue is the fallback. #122 resolved 2026-10-13 (Bot Fight Mode off). n8n email/Slack delivery not yet configured: no email or Slack credential exists in n8n. Status stays failing until QA verifies.
